shortDescription: Bihar Police Constable Special Branch PST Admit Card 2026 released. Download the admit card for CSBC Advt. No. 01/2026 from the official portal.
content:
Central Selection Board of Constable (CSBC), Bihar has released the Bihar Police Constable Special Branch PST Admit Card 2026 for Advt. No. 01/2026.

The recruitment is for 83 Constable (General Duty Close Cadre) posts in the Special Branch of Bihar Police. Candidates should download the admit card, verify their personal details and report at the venue with the required documents.

The PST/DV stage is scheduled for 12 September 2026. The admit card is available from 05 September 2026 through the official CSBC application portal.
